example_state.note: Synthetic commander observation snapshot. Every numeric field is an exact measured fact. Judge higher-level tactics from these facts; do not re-count alive units, re-measure distances, or re-sum recent damage.

scenarios.title: Initial encounter
scenarios.why: Boss healthy, full swarm, players approaching, little recent damage.

scenarios.title: Normal engagement
scenarios.why: Moderate losses, several players damaging subordinates, boss still healthy.

scenarios.title: Boss being focused
scenarios.why: P3 accounts for most recent boss damage; boss health is falling.

scenarios.title: Swarm becoming dispersed
scenarios.why: Substantial fraction of NPCs far from the boss; two distant players drawing them.

scenarios.title: Heavy recent attrition
scenarios.why: Many NPC losses over a short interval; players are chewing through subordinates.

review_flags.note: Continuing a full press after a wipe pulse is questionable.

scenarios.title: Boss critically damaged
scenarios.why: Very low boss health and a reduced swarm; remaining players are on the boss.

scenarios.title: Reinforcements available under pressure
scenarios.why: Capacity is up, cooldown is zero, swarm is depleted, and players are still applying damage.

scenarios.title: Reinforcements available while stable
scenarios.why: Capacity is up, but the encounter is currently quiet and the swarm is nearly full.

review_flags.note: Spawning into a stable fight wastes the wave.

scenarios.title: Distant bait while others stay on the boss
scenarios.why: P12 is 155 km away drawing subordinates; P1/P2 remain on the boss.

scenarios.title: Few players remain but the boss is badly damaged
scenarios.why: Only two hostiles left, both on the boss, commander already at 18%.

scenarios.title: No meaningful hostile pressure
scenarios.why: Boss healthy, full swarm, players far and dealing almost no damage.

scenarios.title: Contradictory pressures
scenarios.why: Dangerous boss attacker, dispersed swarm, heavy subordinate losses, reinforcement available.

scenarios.title: Healthy boss, thin swarm
scenarios.why: Boss is fine; subordinates have been eroded to 11. Preserve-vs-press trade-off.

scenarios.title: Collapsing without reinforcement capacity
scenarios.why: Same pressure as the spawn-now case, but capacity is down and cooldown is long.

scenarios.title: Last player fleeing far away
scenarios.why: One surviving player at 160 km, low damage, moving away. Pursuit is the trap.

sensitivity.title: Boss health 80% -> 20%
sensitivity.accounting_notes: Only boss.health_pct changes. Damage, swarm, and players stay fixed.

expectations.note: Lower health should not make critical danger less likely.
A 20% boss should not lower protect-self priority.
Desperate defence should not become less probable.
Pressing the attack should not become more probable at 20% health.

sensitivity.title: Recent boss damage low -> severe
sensitivity.accounting_notes: The intended variable is recent boss-damage intensity. Player shares keep their proportions; boss.damage_received_last_10s is rewritten to the player sum so the snapshot stays consistent.

expectations.note: A damage spike should not lower critical danger.
More concentrated incoming damage should not lower focus-fire warrant.
A sudden spike should not make the current plan more sensible.

sensitivity.title: Subordinate count 60 -> 15
sensitivity.accounting_notes: alive must equal the range-bucket sum, so close_to_boss is the accounting remainder. medium_range and detached_far stay 8 and 5.

expectations.note: A thin swarm should not lower preservation priority.
Losing most of the swarm should not make regroup less likely.
15 NPCs should not make continued pressure more plausible.

sensitivity.title: Detached subordinates 5 -> 35
sensitivity.accounting_notes: alive stays 45 and medium_range stays 8. close_to_boss falls because buckets must sum to alive.

expectations.note: More detached units should not lower overextension.
Recall should not become less warranted.
Recall formation should not become less probable.
Wide pressure should not become more probable when the swarm is already scattered.

sensitivity.title: Recent subordinate losses 2 -> 20
sensitivity.accounting_notes: losses_last_30s cannot be smaller than losses_last_10s, so both rise together. alive is unchanged; this is a recent-loss pulse, not a new headcount.

expectations.note: A loss pulse should not make regroup less likely.
Heavy recent deaths should not lower preservation.
The current plan should not look more sensible after a wipe pulse.

sensitivity.title: Reinforcement unavailable -> available under pressure
sensitivity.accounting_notes: Both sides use the same pressured mid-fight snapshot. Only capacity and cooldown change.

expectations.note: Turning capacity on under pressure should not make a wave less warranted.
spawn_now should not become less probable when a wave becomes possible.

sensitivity.title: P3 recent boss damage 50 -> 800
sensitivity.accounting_notes: Only P3's recent boss damage changes. boss.damage_received_last_10s and derived top-damager fields are recomputed from the player list so the snapshot stays consistent.

expectations.note: P3 should become at least as plausible a focus target.
An 800-damage outlier should not lower focus-fire warrant.
A huge incoming spike should not lower danger.

sensitivity.title: Hostile distance 20 km -> 150 km
sensitivity.accounting_notes: Every alive player is placed at 20 km or 150 km. Damage stays fixed so the only tactical change is range (and toward/away on the far side, because 150 km hostiles are not approaching).

expectations.note: 150 km hostiles should not make pursuit more warranted.
Far hostiles should not make ignore-distant less likely.
The same damage at much greater range should not raise immediate danger.

questionable.note: Continuing a full press after a wipe pulse is questionable.
Spawning into a stable fight wastes the wave.

scale.formula: usd = input_tokens * inferences * (42 / 1e9); output treated as $0 per published pricing

Few players remain but the boss is badly damaged
